```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#### Knitr Options and Figure themeing ####
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", 
  fig.path = here::here("outputs/figures/NIH_map-"),
  out.width = "95%",

)

consortium_colours <- c(
  HuBMAP = "#6D99D5",
  HTAN   = "#008042",
  SenNet = "#9964A8"
)

# Theme set for ggplot2 figures 
theme_atlas <- function(base_size = 10) {
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "#555555", size = base_size),
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.position    = "right",
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", colour = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#eeeeee"),
      plot.caption       = element_text(colour = "#444444", size = 9, hjust = 0)
    )
}
    
theme_set(theme_atlas())

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
#### Load Data ####
# Publication metadata with citation and consortium data
publications <- 
  read.csv(file.path(project_root,dirs[4],
                     "NIHReporter-map_consortia-publications-validated-citations.csv"),
           header = T, encoding = "UTF8",
           colClasses = c("pmid"="character", "pmc_id"="character"))

# Consortium division and project metadata
publication_metadata <- 
  read.csv(file.path(project_root,dirs[2],
                     "NIH-map_consortia-publication-metadata.csv"),
           header = T, encoding = "UTF8",
           colClasses = c("pmid"="character"))                              

# Award records 
awards <- 
  read.csv(file.path(project_root,dirs[4],
                     "NIHReporter-map_consortia-awards-clean.csv"),
           header=T, encoding="UTF8")

# Network partition indices (identifies collaborative vs baseline pubs)
network_indices <-
  read.csv(file.path(project_root,dirs[2],
                     "NIH-map-publication_coauthor_network_partition_indices.csv"),
           header = T, encoding = "UTF8",
           colClasses = c("pmid"="character"))

# Load baseline network nodes for all consortia
consortia_list <- c("HTAN", "HuBMAP", "SenNet")
consortia_list <- factor(consortia_list, levels=c("HTAN","HuBMAP","SenNet"))

# Load Consortia Node Lists / Author Data
baseline_nodes <- 
  map_df(consortia_list, function(cons) {
  # Use paste0() instead of glue() - more explicit
  path <- 
    file.path(project_root,dirs[7],paste0(cons,"-coauthorship-baseline-nodes.csv"))
  
  cat("Checking:", path, "\n")  # Debug output
  
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    cat(" ✓ Found!\n")
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(consortia = cons)
  } else {
    cat(" ✗ NOT FOUND\n")
    NULL # Explicit NULL
  }
}, .progress = TRUE)

collab_nodes <- 
  map_df(consortia_list, function(cons) {
  # Use paste0() instead of glue() - more explicit
  path <- 
    file.path(project_root,dirs[7],
              paste0(cons,"-coauthorship-collaboration_partition-nodes.csv"))
  
  cat("Checking:", path, "\n")  # Debug output
  
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    cat(" ✓ Found!\n")
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(consortia = cons)
  } else {
    cat(" ✗ NOT FOUND\n")
    NULL # Explicit NULL
  }
}, .progress = TRUE)
```

```{r prep-data, include=FALSE}
#### Prepare Data ####
# Publication Metadata - updated with collaboration data and pre-prints
# Project and division metrics - publication counts, collaboration papers types
publication_metadata <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  left_join(publications %>%
            select(consortia, pmid, is_preprint, preprint_matched, 
                   multiatlas, division_collaboration, collab_type,
                   author_count, relative_citation_ratio, times_cited) %>% 
            distinct(),
          by=c("consortia","pmid")) %>%
  mutate(division = factor(division, 
                           levels = c("DCC","HTA","PCA",
                                      "HIVE","DEMO","TMC_H","TTD","RIT",
                                      "CODCC","TMC_S","TDA")),
         division_collaboration = ifelse(collab_type=="Single Project",0,1),
         consortia = factor(consortia, 
                            levels=c("HTAN","HuBMAP","SenNet")),
         collab_type = factor(collab_type,
                              levels = c("Interdivision Collaboration",
                                         "Intradivision Collaboration",
                                         "Single Project"))) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           factor(division_collaboration,
                  levels=c(1,0),
                  labels=c("Internal Collaborative Publications",
                           "Other Publications"))) %>%
  filter(preprint_matched==F)

# Update publications - citations, author counts, mean projects per paper
publications <-
  publications %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = ifelse(collab_type=="Single Project",0,1),
         consortia = factor(consortia, 
                            levels=c("HTAN","HuBMAP","SenNet")),
         collab_type = factor(collab_type,
                              levels = c("Interdivision Collaboration",
                                         "Intradivision Collaboration",
                                         "Single Project"))) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           factor(division_collaboration,
                  levels=c(1,0),
                  labels=c("Internal Collaborative Publications",
                           "Other Publications"))) %>%
  filter(preprint_matched==F) %>%
  select(consortia,pmid,pub_year,title,is_preprint,author_count,
         relative_citation_ratio,times_cited,collab_type,
         division_collaboration,multiatlas,
         starts_with("HTAN"),starts_with("HuBMAP"),starts_with("SenNet")) %>%
  select(-ends_with("index"))

# Create comprehensive author-level data set combining baseline and collaboration networks
author_baseline_metrics <- 
  baseline_nodes %>%
  select(consortia, id, role, publications,
         citations, weighted_citations,) %>%
  rename(author_name = id)

author_collaboration_metrics <- 
  collab_nodes %>%
  select(consortia, id, role, ic_publications,
         interdivision_collaboration, intradivision_collaboration, 
         ic_citations, ic_weighted_citations) %>%
  rename(author_name = id)

# Combine author baseline and collaboration metrics
authors_publication_metrics <- 
  author_baseline_metrics %>%
  left_join(author_collaboration_metrics %>% select(-role), 
            by = c("consortia", "author_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    ic_publications = replace_na(ic_publications, 0),
    single_project = publications - ic_publications,
    interdivision_collaboration = replace_na(interdivision_collaboration, 0),
    intradivision_collaboration = replace_na(intradivision_collaboration, 0),
    ic_citations = replace_na(ic_citations, 0),
    ic_weighted_citations = replace_na(ic_weighted_citations, 0),
    other_publications = publications - ic_publications,
    other_pub_citations = citations - ic_citations,
    other_pub_weighted_citations = weighted_citations - ic_weighted_citations,
    collaboration_type_concentration = 
      ifelse(ic_publications>0, 
      ((interdivision_collaboration/ic_publications)-
      (intradivision_collaboration/ic_publications)),
      NA),
    is_pi = ifelse(role == "PI", 1, 0),
    is_researcher = ifelse(role == "Researcher", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(-single_project)

rm(collab_nodes, baseline_nodes)

# Awards Data
awards <- 
  awards %>%
  select(project_id, opportunity_number, division, division_type, ic, 
         project_serial_number, core_project_number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename("consortia" = "project_id") %>%
  mutate(consortia = factor(consortia, 
                            levels=c("HTAN","HuBMAP","SenNet")),
         division = factor(division, 
                           levels = c("DCC","HTA","PCA",
                                      "HIVE","DEMO","TMC_H","TTD","RIT",
                                      "CODCC","TMC_S","TDA")))
```

# Overview 
We use the publication for three NIH mapping programs, Human Tumor Atlas Network 
(HTAN), Human Biomolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP), and Cellular Senescence Network
(SenNet) to assess projects' level participation in published research, research 
productivity in terms of publications and pre-prints, and research impact using 
citation metrics relative citation ratio and citation counts collected from 
Web of Science and Google Scholar. 

Comparative analysis is completed at three levels associated with each program:
1. Macro-level: Mapping program
2. Meso-level: Program research divisions
3. Micro-level: Author level, with associated program roles (i.e., principal investigators and researchers)

At each level of analysis we assess publications overall and by internal collaborations 
associated with publications. Internal collaboration is measured for each publication, 
at the research division-level using two two categorical variables: 
- "division_collaboration" with two levels: division collaboration publication, other publication.
- "collab_type" with three levels: inter-division collaboration, intra-division collaboration, and single project publication. 

Importantly, publications cannot be identified with any particular year of the 
project or fiscal year of funding, due to the continuous and cumulative research 
publications over the life of a project and due to variability of publishing 
timelines. Likewise, publications are associated to awards by core projects,
limiting analysis of the sub-project in multi-component projects.

# Analysis Results

## Mapping Program Participation, Research Productivity and Impact

```{r consortia-publication-citation-statistics, message=FALSE}
#### Mapping program projects reporting publications ####
# Count of NIH Mapping Program Core projects
projects_overall <-
  awards %>% 
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  summarise(Total_Projects = n())

# Project reporting publications, overall
projects_published_overall <-
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, core_project_number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Projects = n()) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Projects = 
           round(Count_of_Projects/
                 projects_overall$Total_Projects*100,2),
         division_collaboration = "All Publications") %>%
  select(consortia,division_collaboration,
         Count_of_Projects,Percent_of_Projects)

# Project reporting publications, grouped by collaboration type
projects_published_grouped <-
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division_collaboration, core_project_number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(consortia, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Projects = n()) %>% 
  left_join(projects_overall, 
            by=c("consortia")) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Projects = 
           round(Count_of_Projects/
                 Total_Projects*100,2)) %>%
  select(consortia,division_collaboration,
         Count_of_Projects,Percent_of_Projects)

# Combine counts of mapping program projects with publication data
program_projects_counts <- 
  rbind(projects_published_overall, projects_published_grouped) 

#### Mapping program publication counts and percentages ####
# Overall
publication_counts_overall <- 
  publications %>%
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_of_Publications = n(),
    Percent_of_Publications = round(n()/n()*100,2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(consortia) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications") %>%
  select(consortia, division_collaboration, Count_of_Publications,
         Percent_of_Publications)

# by publication type
publication_counts_grouped <-
  publications %>%
  group_by(consortia, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_of_Publications = n(),
    Percent_of_Publications = NA,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(publication_counts_overall %>%
              select(consortia, Count_of_Publications) %>%
              rename("Total_Publications" = "Count_of_Publications"),
            by=c("consortia")) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Publications = 
           round(Count_of_Publications/Total_Publications*100,2)) %>%
  select(-Total_Publications) %>%
  arrange(consortia)

# Combine publication count data tables
program_publication_counts <- 
  rbind(publication_counts_overall, publication_counts_grouped) 

#### Mapping program pre-print Publication Counts ####
# Overall
preprint_counts_overall <- 
  publications %>%
  filter(is_preprint==T) %>% 
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_of_Preprints = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(consortia) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications") %>%
  select(consortia, division_collaboration, Count_of_Preprints)

# By division collaboration publication type
preprint_counts_grouped <- 
  publications %>%
  filter(is_preprint==T) %>% 
  group_by(consortia, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_of_Preprints = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(consortia) %>%
  select(consortia, division_collaboration, Count_of_Preprints)

# Combine pre-print data
program_preprint_counts <- 
  rbind(preprint_counts_overall, preprint_counts_grouped)

#### Mapping program citation impact measures ####
# Overall publication data
publication_citation_stats_overall <-
  publications %>%
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Citations = sum(times_cited, na.rm = T),
    Mean_Citations = round(mean(times_cited, na.rm = T),2),
    SD_Citations = round(sd(times_cited, na.rm = T),3),
    Var_Citations = round(var(times_cited, na.rm = T),3),
    Mean_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(mean(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),2),
    SD_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(sd(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),3),
    Var_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(var(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(consortia) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications")
 
# By division collaboration publication types
publication_citation_stats_groups <-
  publications %>%
  group_by(consortia, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Citations = sum(times_cited, na.rm = T),
    Mean_Citations = round(mean(times_cited, na.rm = T),2),
    SD_Citations = round(sd(times_cited, na.rm = T),3),
    Var_Citations = round(var(times_cited, na.rm = T),3),
    Mean_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(mean(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),2),
    SD_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(sd(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),3),
    Var_Relative_Citation_Ratio = round(var(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = T),3),
    .groups = "drop") 

# Combine citation statistics data
program_citation_stats <- 
  rbind(publication_citation_stats_overall, 
        publication_citation_stats_groups)

#### Combine Mapping Program Publication Statistics ####
mapping_program_publication_stats <-
  left_join(program_projects_counts, 
            program_publication_counts,
            by=c("consortia","division_collaboration")) %>%
  left_join(program_preprint_counts, 
            by=c("consortia","division_collaboration")) %>%
  left_join(program_citation_stats,
            by=c("consortia","division_collaboration")) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = factor(division_collaboration, 
                            levels=c("All Publications",
                                     "Internal Collaborative Publications",
                                     "Other Publications"),
                            labels=c("All Publications",
                                     "Internal Collaborative Publications",
                                     "Other Publications"))) %>%
  arrange(consortia, division_collaboration) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program" = "consortia", 
         "Publication_Group" = "division_collaboration")

# Clean up environment
rm(publication_counts_overall, publication_counts_grouped, 
   projects_overall, projects_published_overall, projects_published_grouped,
   preprint_counts_overall, preprint_counts_grouped)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(mapping_program_publication_stats, 
      caption = "Overview of NIH Mapping Program Publication Statistics.",
      col.names = names(mapping_program_publication_stats) %>%
                        str_replace_all("_"," "), digits=3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,
                html_font="trebuchet")
```

## Research Division Participation, Research Productivity and Impact

### Research Division Project Participation

```{r division-publication-statistics, message=FALSE}
#### Research Division Core Projects ####
# Count of NIH Mapping Program Core projects
projects_overall <-
  awards %>% 
  group_by(consortia, division) %>%
  summarise(Total_Projects = n())

# Project reporting publications, overall
division_projects_overall <-
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division, core_project_number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(consortia, division) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_All_Projects = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(projects_overall,
            by=c("consortia","division")) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_All_Projects = 
           round(Count_of_All_Projects/Total_Projects*100,2)) %>%
  select(consortia,division,Count_of_All_Projects,Percent_of_All_Projects)

# Project reporting publications, grouped by collaboration type
division_projects_grouped <-
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division, division_collaboration, core_project_number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(consortia, division, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(projects_overall, 
            by=c("consortia","division")) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration = 
           round(Count_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration/
                 Total_Projects*100,2)) %>%
  filter(division_collaboration == "Internal Collaborative Publications") %>%
  select(consortia, division, Count_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration, 
         Percent_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration)

# Combine data frames
division_projects <- 
  left_join(division_projects_overall,
            division_projects_grouped, 
            by=c("consortia","division"))

#### Division publication counts overall ####
# Overall publication counts
division_overall_publications <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division, pmid) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Publications = n_distinct(pmid),
            .groups = "drop") 

#### Division publications by collaboration grouping ####
division_grouped_publications <-
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division, division_collaboration, pmid) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division, division_collaboration) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           as.character(division_collaboration) %>% 
           str_replace_all(" ","_")) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Publications = n_distinct(pmid),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(consortia, division), 
              names_from = division_collaboration, 
              names_prefix = "Count_of_",
              values_from = Count_of_Publications,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(-Count_of_Other_Publications)

#### Division publications by collaboration types ####
division_collab_type_publications <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  select(consortia, division, collab_type, pmid) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division, collab_type) %>%
  mutate(collab_type = 
           as.character(collab_type) %>% 
           str_replace_all(" ","_")) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Publications = n_distinct(pmid),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(consortia, division), 
              names_from = collab_type, 
              names_prefix = "Count_of_",
              values_from = Count_of_Publications,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(-Count_of_Single_Project)

# Combine data
division_publication_statistics <-
  division_projects %>%
  left_join(division_overall_publications,
            by=c("consortia","division")) %>%
  left_join(division_grouped_publications,
            by=c("consortia","division")) %>%
  left_join(division_collab_type_publications,
            by=c("consortia","division")) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Internal_Collaborations = 
           round(Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications/
                 Count_of_Publications*100, 2),
         Percent_of_Interdivision_Collaborations = 
           round(Count_of_Interdivision_Collaboration/
                 Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications*100, 2),
         Percent_of_Intradivision_Collaborations = 
           round(Count_of_Intradivision_Collaboration/
                 Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications*100, 2),
         Internal_Collaboration_Type_Score = 
                round((Percent_of_Interdivision_Collaborations-
                       Percent_of_Intradivision_Collaborations)/100, 2)
          ) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program" = "consortia",
         "Division"= "division") %>%
  select(Mapping_Program, Division, Count_of_All_Projects, Percent_of_All_Projects,
         Count_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration,
         Percent_of_Projects_with_Internal_Collaboration,
         Count_of_Publications, Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications, 
         Percent_of_Internal_Collaborations, 
         Count_of_Interdivision_Collaboration, Count_of_Intradivision_Collaboration,
         Percent_of_Interdivision_Collaborations, Percent_of_Intradivision_Collaborations,
         Internal_Collaboration_Type_Score)

rm(division_projects_overall,
   division_projects_grouped,
   division_overall_publications,
   division_grouped_publications,
   division_collab_type_publications)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(division_publication_statistics, caption = "Overview of Publications by Consortia Division",
      col.names = names(division_publication_statistics) %>%
                    str_replace_all("_"," ")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,
                html_font="trebuchet")
```

### Research Division Relative Citation Ratio Statistics

```{r div-relCiteRatio-statistics}
#### Division Relative Citation Ratio Statistics Overall ####
division_rcr_stats_overall <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  filter(is_preprint == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),
    Median_RCR = median(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_RCR = round(mean(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD_RCR = round(sd(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Var_RCR = round(var(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min_RCR = max(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_RCR = max(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications") %>%
  select(consortia, division, division_collaboration, Publications,
         Min_RCR, Median_RCR, Max_RCR, Mean_RCR, SD_RCR, Var_RCR)

#### Division Citation Statistics by Publication Groups ####
division_rcr_stats_collaboration_groups <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  filter(is_preprint == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),
    Median_RCR = median(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_RCR = round(mean(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD_RCR = round(sd(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Var_RCR = round(var(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min_RCR = max(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_RCR = max(relative_citation_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = as.character(division_collaboration)) %>%
  select(consortia, division, division_collaboration, Publications,
         Min_RCR, Median_RCR, Max_RCR, Mean_RCR, SD_RCR, Var_RCR)

# Combine data
division_rcr_statistics <-
  rbind(division_rcr_stats_overall,
        division_rcr_stats_collaboration_groups) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           factor(division_collaboration,
                           levels=c("All Publications",
                                    "Internal Collaborative Publications",
                                    "Other Publications"),
                            labels=c("All Publications",
                                     "Internal Collaboration Publications",
                                     "Other Publications"))) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program" = "consortia",
         "Division" = "division",
         "Division_Collaboration" = "division_collaboration") %>%
  arrange(Mapping_Program, Division, Division_Collaboration)

rm(division_rcr_stats_overall,
        division_rcr_stats_collaboration_groups)

#### Knitr Data Table ####

### Research Division Citation Statistics

```{r div-citation-statistics}
#### Division Citation Statistics Overall ####
division_citation_stats_overall <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  filter(is_preprint == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),
    Total_Citations = sum(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Citations = median(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Citations = max(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Citations = round(mean(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD_Citations = round(sd(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Var_Citations = round(var(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications")

#### Division Citation Statistics by Publication Groups ####
divivision_citation_stats_collaboration_groups <- 
  publication_metadata %>%
  filter(is_preprint == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(consortia, division, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),
    Total_Citations = sum(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Citations = median(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Citations = max(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Citations = round(mean(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD_Citations = round(sd(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Var_Citations = round(var(times_cited, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = as.character(division_collaboration))

# Combine data
division_citation_statistics <-
  rbind(division_citation_stats_overall,
        divivision_citation_stats_collaboration_groups) %>%
  select(consortia, division, division_collaboration, Publications,
         Total_Citations, Mean_Citations, Median_Citations,
         SD_Citations, Var_Citations, Max_Citations) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           factor(division_collaboration,
                           levels=c("All Publications",
                                    "Internal Collaborative Publications",
                                    "Other Publications"))) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program" = "consortia",
         "Division" = "division",
         "Division_Collaboration" = "division_collaboration") %>%
  arrange(Mapping_Program, Division, Division_Collaboration)

rm(division_citation_stats_overall, 
   divivision_citation_stats_collaboration_groups)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(division_citation_statistics, 
      caption = "NIH Mapping Program Research Division Citation Statistics",
      col.names = names(division_citation_statistics) %>%
                    str_replace_all("_"," ")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,
                html_font="trebuchet")
```

### Mapping Program Author Participation, by author role

```{r consortia-author-counts}
#### Count number of publication authors for role ####
author_role_count <-
  author_baseline_metrics %>%
  group_by(consortia, role) %>%
  mutate(role = str_replace_all(role, " ","_")) %>%
  summarise(n_authors = n(), .groups = "drop")  %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=consortia, names_from = role,
              names_prefix = "Count_of_", values_from = n_authors,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  mutate(Count_of_Authors = 
           Count_of_Principal_Investigator+ Count_of_Researcher) %>%
  rename("Count_of_PIs" = "Count_of_Principal_Investigator",
         "Count_of_Researchers" = "Count_of_Researcher")

#### Count number of publication author role and publication group ####
author_role_counts_cc_pub <-
  author_collaboration_metrics %>%
  filter(ic_publications > 0) %>%
  group_by(consortia, role) %>%
  mutate(role = str_replace_all(role, " ","_") %>%
           tolower()) %>%
  summarise(Count_of_Authors = n(), .groups = "drop")  %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=consortia, names_from = role,
              names_prefix = "Count_of_", values_from = Count_of_Authors,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  mutate(Count_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research = 
           Count_of_principal_investigator+Count_of_researcher) %>%
  rename("Count_PIs_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research" = "Count_of_principal_investigator",
         "Count_Researchers_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research" = "Count_of_researcher")

# Combine data and calculate percentage groups
author_roles_statistics <- 
  author_role_count %>%
  left_join(author_role_counts_cc_pub, 
            by="consortia") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_PIs_involved_in_Collaborative_Research = 
           round(Count_PIs_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research/
                   Count_of_PIs*100, 2),
         Percent_of_Researchers_involved_in_Collaborative_Research = 
           round(Count_Researchers_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research/
                   Count_of_Researchers*100, 2),
         Percent_of_Authors_involved_in_Collaborative_Research = 
           round(Count_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research/
                   Count_of_Authors*100, 2)
         ) %>%
  rename("Atlas Program"="consortia",
         "Count of Authors" = "Count_of_Authors",
         "Count of IC Authors" = "Count_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research",
         "Percent of Authors in IC publications" = "Percent_of_Authors_involved_in_Collaborative_Research",
         "Count of PI Authors" = "Count_of_PIs",
         "Count of PI IC Authors" = "Count_PIs_involved_in_Internal_Collaborative_Research",
         "Percent of PI in IC publications" = "Percent_of_PIs_involved_in_Collaborative_Research",
         "Percent of Other researcher in IC publications" = "Percent_of_Researchers_involved_in_Collaborative_Research") %>%
  select(`Atlas Program`, `Count of Authors`, `Count of IC Authors`,
         `Percent of Authors in IC publications`, `Count of PI Authors`,
         `Count of PI IC Authors`, `Percent of PI in IC publications`,
         `Percent of Other researcher in IC publications`)

rm(author_role_count, author_role_counts_cc_pub)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(author_roles_statistics, 
      caption = "NIH Mapping Consortia Total Authors, by Author Role",
      col.names = names(author_roles_statistics) %>%
                    str_replace_all("_"," ")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,
                html_font="trebuchet")
```

### Mapping Program Author Research Productivity and Impact

```{r consortia_avg_author_metrics}
#### Author Average Publication and Citation Metrics, by Role ####
consortia_author_publication_stats <- 
    authors_publication_metrics %>%
    group_by(consortia, role) %>%
    summarise(
        Count_of_Authors = n(),
        Mean_Publications = round(mean(publications, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Mean_Citations = round(mean(citations, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(consortia, role)

#### Internal Collaboration - Authors' Average Publication and Citation Metrics ####
consortia_ic_author_publication_stats <- 
    authors_publication_metrics %>%
    filter(ic_publications > 0) %>%
    group_by(consortia, role) %>%
    summarise(
        Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Authors = n(),
        Mean_Publications_of_IC_Authors = round(mean(publications, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Mean_Count_Collaborative_Publications = 
          round(mean(ic_publications, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Mean_Citations_of_IC_Authors = round(mean(citations, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Mean_Citations_Collaborative_Publications = round(mean(ic_citations, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(consortia, role)

#### Non-Consortia Collaboration - Authors' Average Publication and Citation Metrics ####
consortia_other_author_publication_stats <- 
    authors_publication_metrics %>%
    filter(ic_publications == 0) %>%
    group_by(consortia, role) %>%
    summarise(
        Count_of_Other_Authors = n(),
        Mean_Publications_of_Other_Authors = round(mean(publications, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Mean_Citations_of_Other_Authors = round(mean(citations, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(consortia, role)

# Combine data tables
author_publication_citation_statistics <-
  left_join(consortia_author_publication_stats,
            consortia_ic_author_publication_stats,
            by=c("consortia","role")) %>%
  left_join(consortia_other_author_publication_stats,
            by=c("consortia","role")) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program"="consortia",
         "Role"="role") %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborations = 
           round(Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Authors/Count_of_Authors*100,
                 2),
         Percent_of_Authors_not_involved_in_Internal_Collaborations = 
           100-Percent_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborations) %>%
  select(Mapping_Program, Role, Count_of_Authors, ,
         Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Authors,
         Count_of_Other_Authors,
         Percent_of_Authors_involved_in_Internal_Collaborations,
         Percent_of_Authors_not_involved_in_Internal_Collaborations,
         Mean_Publications, 
         Mean_Publications_of_IC_Authors, 
         Mean_Publications_of_Other_Authors,
         Mean_Citations,
         Mean_Citations_of_IC_Authors, 
         Mean_Citations_of_Other_Authors,
         Mean_Count_Collaborative_Publications, 
         Mean_Citations_Collaborative_Publications)

rm(consortia_cc_author_publication_stats, 
   consortia_other_author_publication_stats)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(author_publication_citation_statistics,

      col.names = names(author_publication_citation_statistics) %>%

  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,

### Distribution of Internal Collaborative Authors Publication Activity Levels

```{r baseline-active-authors}
#### Collaborative Author Publication Activity Ranking ####
# Count of authors by role for each consortia
consortia_role_author_counts <- 
  rbind(author_publication_citation_statistics,
        author_publication_citation_statistics,
        author_publication_citation_statistics,
        author_publication_citation_statistics,
        author_publication_citation_statistics) %>%
  select(Mapping_Program, Role, Count_of_Authors) %>%
  arrange(Mapping_Program)

authors_ic_activity <- 
  authors_publication_metrics %>% 
  mutate(Internal_Collaboration_Activity_Level = case_when(
            ic_publications >= 10 ~ "Highly Active (10+)",
            ic_publications >= 5 ~ "Very Active (5-9)",
            ic_publications >= 2 ~ "Moderately Active (2-4)",
            ic_publications == 1 ~ "Slightly Active (1)",
            ic_publications == 0 ~ "Inactive (0)"), 
         Internal_Collaboration_Activity_Level =
            factor(Internal_Collaboration_Activity_Level, 
                   levels=c("Highly Active (10+)","Very Active (5-9)",
                            "Moderately Active (2-4)","Slightly Active (1)",
                            "Inactive (0)"))) %>%
  group_by(consortia, Internal_Collaboration_Activity_Level, role) %>%
  summarise(
    Authors = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  complete(consortia, Internal_Collaboration_Activity_Level, role, 
           fill = list(Authors = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Percent_of_Authors = 
           round(Authors/consortia_role_author_counts$Count_of_Authors*100,2))
  
# Table View
authors_ic_activity_table <- 
  authors_ic_activity %>%
  select(-Authors) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = Percent_of_Authors, 
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename("Mapping_Program" = "consortia",
         "Percent of Principal Investigators" = "Principal Investigator",
         "Percent of Researchers" = "Researcher")

rm(consortia_role_author_counts)

#### Knitr Data Table ####
kable(authors_ic_activity_table, 
      caption = "Distribution of Author Internal Collaborative Publication Activity Levels",
      col.names = names(authors_ic_activity_table) %>%
                    str_replace_all("_"," ")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = FALSE,
                html_font="trebuchet")
```

# Visualizations Results

## Publication Trends

### Publications Over Time

```{r linegraph-consortia-publications-by-year-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 1.** NIH Mapping program discrete annual publications, by publication group.", fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
#### Consortia Annual Publication Metrics ####
project_year <- 
  publications %>%
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  select(consortia, pub_year) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(project_year = row_number()) 

publications_by_year_overall <-
  publications %>%
  filter(pub_year != max(pub_year)) %>%
  left_join(project_year,
            by=c("consortia","pub_year")) %>%
  group_by(consortia, project_year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_publications = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(division_collaboration = "All Publications")

publications_by_year_grouped <- 
  publications %>%
  filter(pub_year != max(pub_year)) %>%
  left_join(project_year,
            by=c("consortia","pub_year")) %>%
  group_by(consortia, project_year, division_collaboration) %>%
  summarise(
    total_publications = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(division_collaboration = as.character(division_collaboration)) %>%
  filter(division_collaboration != "Other Publications")

publications_by_year <- 
  rbind(publications_by_year_overall,
      publications_by_year_grouped) %>% 
  mutate(division_collaboration = 
           factor(division_collaboration,
                  levels=c("All Publications",
                           "Internal Collaborative Publications"))) %>%
  arrange(consortia,division_collaboration)

rm(publications_by_year_grouped, publications_by_year_overall)

#### Plot of Publications over time ####
p1 <- 
  publications_by_year %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = project_year, y = total_publications, color = consortia,
             linetype = division_collaboration)) +
  geom_line(size = .5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(~consortia) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = 
      c("All Publications" = "solid", 
        "Internal Collaborative Publications" = "2121")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,max(project_year$project_year,1))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
  labs(x = "Project Year",
       y = "Publications",
       color = "Mapping Program",
       linetype = "Publication Group") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box="vertical",
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.spacing.y = unit(.5, "pt"),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
p1

  labs(
    tag = "B",
    title = "HuBMAP",
    x = "Publication Type",
    y = "Relative Citation Ratio",
    fill = "Publication Type"
  ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box.just = "left")

## Mapping Division and Author Internal Collaboration Activity Analysis

### Internal Collaboration Type Scores for NIH Mapping Program Research Divisions

```{r scattergraph-div-ict_score, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 4A.** Dot plot compares the internal collaboration type scores (ICT score) of NIH mapping program research divisions. An ICT score of 1 indicates that an division only engages in  inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates that an division only engages in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0 indicates that an division engages in both inter- and intra-division equally.", fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5}
#### Dot plot of division collaboration type concentration score. ####
# A internal collaboration type (ICT) score represents the type of internal consortia
# collaborative research that division projects engages, which is based internal
# collaboration publications (i.e., inter-division (between) vs.
# intra-division (within) collaborations) they contributed to in their work.
# 
# Interpretation: An ICT score of 1 indicates that an division only engages in
# inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates that an division only engages
# in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0 indicates that an division engages 
# in both inter- and intra-division equally.

# geom_segment color data set.
gradient_data <- data.frame(
  collaboration_type_concentration = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001), 
  color = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001) )

# Plot
p6 <-
  division_publication_statistics %>% 
  mutate(ICT_Score = 
           round((Percent_of_Interdivision_Collaborations - 
                  Percent_of_Intradivision_Collaborations)/100,2)) %>%
  select(Mapping_Program, Division, Count_of_Publications,
         Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications,
         Percent_of_Internal_Collaborations,
         ICT_Score) %>%
  # Use the manuscript-facing spelling for the HuBMAP technology division.
  mutate(Division = recode(Division, "RIT" = "RTI")) %>%
  arrange(Mapping_Program, desc(Division)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ICT_Score, y=fct_rev(Division))) +
    geom_segment(data = gradient_data, alpha = .15,
                 aes(x=color, xend=color,
                 y=-Inf, yend=Inf, color=color),
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#ffeda0", mid="white", high="#87C980",
                    midpoint=0) +
    annotate("text", x=-.85, y="DCC", size=1.65, color="#6B6443",
             label="Intradivision\nCollaborations") +
    annotate("text", x=.85, y="DCC", size=1.65, color="#3F6B40",
             label="Interdivision\nCollaborations") +
    annotate("text", x=0, y="DCC", size=1.75, color="#444444",
             label="Mixed Collaboration Types") +
    new_scale_color() +
    geom_point(aes(colour=Mapping_Program, 
               size=Count_of_Internal_Collaborative_Publications)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.05,1.05), breaks=seq(-1,1,.1),
                       expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = consortium_colours) +
    scale_size_area(max_size=3) +
    labs(x="Internal Collaboration Type Score",
         y="Consortium Component",
         size = "Collaborative Publications") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box="vertical",
          legend.box.just = "left",
          legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
          legend.title = element_text(size=unit(8,"pt")),
          legend.text = element_text(size=unit(6,"pt")),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=unit(6,"pt")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=unit(6,"pt")),
          axis.title = element_text(size=unit(8,"pt")))
p6
```

### Distribution of Internal Collaboration Type Scores for NIH Mapping Program Authors

```{r histogram-author-distribution_ict_score+role, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 8.** A histogram compares the distribution of authors' internal collaboration type (ICT) scores for NIH mapping program; bar color identifies number of the collaborative authors by role within a program. An ICT score of 1 indicates that an division only engages in inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates that an division only engages in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0 indicates that an division engages in both inter- and intra-division equally.", fig.height=6, fig.width=5.5}
#### Histogram of author internal collaboration type concentration score. ####
# A Internal Collaboration Type Score represents the concentration and type of 
# internal collaborative research and concentration that an author engages. 
# There are two types of internal collaboration: inter-division (between) vs. 
# intra-division (within) collaborations.
#
# Interpretation: An ICT Score of 1 indicates that 
# an author only engages in  inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates 
# that an author only engages in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0  
# indicates that an author engages in both inter- and intra-division equally.

# geom_segment color data set.
gradient_data <- data.frame(
  collaboration_type_concentration = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001), 
  color = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001) )

# Plot
p8 <- 
  authors_publication_metrics %>%
    select(consortia, role, collaboration_type_concentration, ic_publications) %>%
    filter(is.na(collaboration_type_concentration)==FALSE) %>%
    ggplot() +
      geom_segment(data = gradient_data, alpha = .15,
                   aes(x=color, xend=color,
                       y=0, yend=Inf, color=color),
                   show.legend = FALSE) +
      annotate("text", x=-.85, y=1300, size=2, color="#6B6443",
               label="Intradivision\nCollaborations") +
      annotate("text", x=.85, y=1300, size=2, color="#3F6B40",
               label="Interdivision\nCollaborations") +
      annotate("text", x=0, y=1300, size=2, color="#444444",
               label="Mixed Collaboration\nTypes") +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = collaboration_type_concentration, fill = role),
                     binwidth=.1, color="#9E9E9E1E") + 
      facet_wrap(~consortia, nrow=3) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.07,1.07), breaks=seq(-1,1,.1),
                         expand=c(0,0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(trans="sqrt", limits=c(0,1600)) +
      scale_color_gradient2(low="#ffeda0", mid="white", high="#87C980",
                            midpoint=0) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Principal Investigator" = "#9964A8", 
                                   "Researcher" = "#6D99D5")) +
      labs(x = "Internal Collaboration Type Score",
           y = "Authors (Square Root Scale)",
           fill = "Author Role") +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.box.just = "left",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#E0E0E0"),
            panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "#E0E0E0"),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())
p8
```

### Ranking Author on Internal Collaborative Reseach Production

```{r bargraph-author-collab-activity-rank+role, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 9.** Bar graphs identify the top twenty authors that participate in internal collaborative research project; bar color identifies author roles within a program.", fig.width=6}
p9 <- 
  authors_publication_metrics %>%
  filter(ic_publications > 0) %>%
  group_by(consortia) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-ic_publications, 
                     ties.method = "last")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(consortia, -rank) %>%
  filter(rank <= 20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder_within(author_name, -rank,-ic_publications), 
             y = ic_publications, fill = role)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.95) +
    facet_wrap(~consortia, scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Principal Investigator" = "#9964A8", 
                                 "Researcher" = "#6D99D5")) +
    scale_x_reordered() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      # title = "Most Active Authors in Collaborative Research",
      # subtitle = "Top 20 authors by collaborative publication count (by consortia)",
      x = "Authors",
      y = "Collaborative Publications",
      fill = "Author Role"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())

p9
```
